title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
notes: Private Standard-rules Aztec condition requested by the operator. Only the free Aztec Civilization Pack is enabled; Gathering Storm, Rise and Fall, all other optional content and community mods are disabled. The local scoring rubric and setup are not maintainer-reviewed and must not be represented as a reviewed comparison result.
introduction: Civilization VI is a turn-based empire-building game. This local run uses Standard Rules, an Ancient Era Aztec start under Montezuma, Prince difficulty and one AI opponent. Only Science Victory is enabled. The free Aztec Civilization Pack is the only enabled additional content; expansion rules and community mods are disabled. Defeat occurs if the human civilization is eliminated or another team wins. Gameplay starts from a fixed undeveloped save after one documented preparation turn.
controls: Use left clicks to select units, cities, menu entries and map tiles. Right clicks issue map orders for a selected unit. M selects the move command, which can then be targeted with a left click. The arrow keys pan the map. The configured input profile supplies ordinary keyboard and pointer controls, using fixed points or native Box targets as declared by that profile. Units, research and production choices use the game's visible controls. The game waits for player input between turns; no process pause is used.
